newsitem.title: USA: UniComp up on millennium contract.
newsitem.headline: UniComp up on millennium contract.

text.p: UniComp Inc's shares jumped Monday after the company said its Unibol unit landed a contract to provide the first phase of analysis for the so-called Year 2000 problem.
UniComp's stock jumped 4-11/16 to a new 52-week high of 9-1/2. UniComp also was one of the most active over-the-counter stocks.
The initial phase of the pact with an unnamed worldwide service company is valued at $100,000 UniComp said. The full project is estimated at more than $1.65 million.
Unibol's GO2000 technology provides "impact analysis" consulting to assess the scale of the Year 2000 problem, to define the strategic options for conversion, and to fix the code, UniComp said.
UniComp also said it will increase its sales staff and field operation for the roll-out of its Year 2000 software solutions. The company did not disclose the extent of its hiring plans.
UniComp markets UNIX-based computers and customized software.
